text_block_list.text: —Apparently that instant noodle commercial was a huge hit, so Narita Top Road and Calstone Light O got an offer for a sequel!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I see...! "A documentary-style commercial about crafting ramen-specific chopsticks", is that it?!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
We will feature the two of you giving it your all and eating
with the finished chopsticks in commercials and videos.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Meaning we're building a straightaway?!
Great idea. Let's make it right away, let's make it now.
choice_data_list: (Who knows how this will turn out...!)

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
I've prepared the wood and tools.
We cut it, sand it down,
and paint it, and voila! It's finished.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Cypress, beech, ebony...
There are so many types.
Which one should I choose?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Of course it's that one.
The wood grain on it is the straightest.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
With the fretsaw... gah, it went diagonal!
Then I'll cut the other side—crooked again!
Gaaah! It's just getting smaller and smaller!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
What a disaster.
The lumber has vanished.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Same here...
Detailed, delicate work is so difficult.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Is it not working because I'm cutting it into small pieces?
Maybe having about 1,000 meters of it would do the trick.
All right, let's make it!
choice_data_list: Can you even call those... chopsticks...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You're right...
At times like this, it's best to ask an expert for guidance!

text_block_list.name: Chopstick Artisan
text_block_list.text:
—So that's why you came to our chopstick workshop?
I was wondering who such an unusual customer could be...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I would very much like to seek
the artisan's guidance.

text_block_list.name: Chopstick Artisan
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Go home. There's no way in hell I'm showing off my chopstick-crafting skills for some ridiculous project like that.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Are you k—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I'm not messing around!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Precisely because so many people will see it, I don't want to do a half-hearted job.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Actually... I once looked into traditional crafts to make a vessel of my own.
It was such a profound, fascinating world—!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Accumulating feelings and time to hone one's craft
is a lot like running...
It truly touched my heart.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll make it with everything I've got!
Please, give me this chance!
choice_data_list: Oh, let me ask as well, please...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
—And so...
she has actually come here today!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Huh! That person is...!
The master artist from the news...!?
Wh-Wh-Why!?

text_block_list.name: Chopstick Artisan
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, when someone begs with eyes that pure
and earnest, what else could I do?!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
—Haa, haa, doing this by hand is too slow!
Master, are you sure an electric sander won't do!?

text_block_list.name: Chopstick Artisan
text_block_list.text:
"When shaving it down, fingertip sensitivity is key.
That's what creates a beautiful straight line."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
This is way too tough! Is this the world of craftsmen?!
Does Believe really endure this all the time?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You really have to take your hat off to them.
Doing it purely by the feel of your fingertips is so incredibly difficult.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm still not very good at it,
but I feel like I've improved compared to before.
I'll definitely make something great...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Master, could you take another look?!
How does this angle look to you?"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
“—Top Road-san.
You truly are so straightforward, aren't you?”

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!?
What's gotten into the two of you all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I am impressed.
It showed me that such straightforwardness is also important.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, we crafted the finest homestretch.
My gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Calstone-chan...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much!
Then, let's keep pressing straight ahead to the very end!

And so, the ultimate ramen chopsticks were completed!
"Let's try eating with these right away!"
The director holds up a cue card...
choice_data_list: Looks like the ramen's gonna taste even better.
Looks like the ramen's gonna taste even better!

text_block_list.text:
And so, the ultimate ramen chopsticks were completed!
"Let's try eating with these right away!"
The director holds up a cue card...
choice_data_list: Looks like the ramen's gonna taste even better.
Looks like the ramen's gonna taste even better!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Um...
Then the next location is...
"A famous restaurant that supervises cup noodles!"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
That was delicious!!
So good!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, it was totally worth the effort!
Amazing! Who knew chopsticks could make such a difference!

text_block_list.name: Director
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! Nice!
We got plenty of great footage!
Part two is bound to be a hit for sure!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I've already poured the hot water in.
It's almost three minutes... 5, 4, 3, 2, 1!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let's partake.
Fufu, this moment has finally come.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
*Slurp, slurp...*
Haaaah, so delicious...!
Perhaps because the ramen looked so delicious after all that earnest hard work, the commercial was said to be a huge hit...!

Narrator:
"Straight and smooth noodles,
chewy and delicious!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "Straight-up Deliciousness"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "Straight-up Deliciousness—New Arrival!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah! This commercial!
It's already airing, huh?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: "Watching that made me want to eat some. Let's go buy some! Right now!"
